items.title: [Meta FAIR + NYU] Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding: training 200+ MLLMs to find encoder pretraining is optional but vision-only parameters are not [R]
items.title_zh: Meta FAIR 与 NYU：视觉编码器预训练非必需，视觉专属参数不可少
items.title_en: Meta FAIR/NYU: Vision Encoder Pretraining Optional, Vision-Only Parameters Essential
items.summary: Meta FAIR and NYU train 200+ multimodal LLMs from scratch under matched compute budgets to show that separate vision-encoder pretraining is unnecessary, while dedicated vision-only parameters remain essential.
